
  Barzakh — UEFI Firmware Security Scanner
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════

  Version:       0.7.0
  Detectors:     138
  Architectures: x86_64, aarch64, riscv64
  Report formats: JSON, HTML, Markdown

  Detector Categories:
    • TPM/PCR analysis (PCR, PCR Oracle, PCR Replay, Attestation)
    • Memory forensics (Memory, Hook, Runtime Hook, SMM)
    • Firmware structure (Firmware Volume, SPI Integrity, MBR)
    • Secure Boot chain (SecureBoot, SecureBoot Chain, Differ)
    • Behavioral analysis (Entropy, Self-Erasure, Time Travel)
    • Intel ME/Ring -3 (HECI, ME SPI, AMT, fTPM, ME DMA)
    • Ring -4/Microarch (Microcode, Spectre, Thermal, Voltage, Debug, Rowhammer)
